name: Effect Fill Swatches
description: Procedural GPU Effect fills evaluated as scape3d mesh textures. Boards A-D (codex): environment, condemned, props/wearables, neon-rot interiors. Boards E-F (Claude): the neon-surface dream pole (facades, signage, sky, wet streets, vehicles, screens, palms) and the contraband/crime-scene squalor game-objects. Each material x3 variants x a runtime detail grade (PSX -> Max). See CATALOG.md.
